description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Any tier 3 weapon skill feats, BAB +9

Benefit: At the end of a round of combat, if you or an ally with this teamwork feat starts a chain by using 2 or more tier 3 weapon skill feats will activate this feat automatically, causing the target creature of the weapon skills to take 10 points of non-elemental damage and a -2 penalty on AC and saving throws per weapon skill used during the round for 1 minute, no save.

system.requirements: Any tier 3 weapon skill feats, BAB +9
